#comment: BrixBot shield on the UNO R4: 2 x SN754410 motor drivers + nRF24L01 radio (no hub drivers for these yet). Mirrors ../hub/brixbot_hub/Brix_HwConfig.cpp with BRIX_HWCONFIG__SHIELD 1: each type's slots are the hub's pin table filtered to that type, in table order. D0, D1, A3, A0 are shared: each can be a led or a button. A3 and A0 are also the pot pins.
name: BrixBot shield v1 (Arduino UNO R4)
